west-africa.title: Afirka ta Yamma
west-africa.description: Nijeriya, Ghana, Côte d'Ivoire, Senegal, Mali, Burkina Faso, Gini, Benin, Togo, Saliyo, Laberiya da Nijar — Legas, Accra, Abidjan, Dakar, Abuja, Bamako, Ouagadougou da gaɓar Tekun Gini.

south-central-us.title: Jihohin Kudu ta Tsakiya na Amurka
south-central-us.description: Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, Louisiana, Kentucky, Tennessee, Mississippi da Alabama — Houston, Dallas, San Antonio, Austin, Oklahoma City, Tulsa, Little Rock, New Orleans, Louisville, Nashville, Memphis, Jackson da Birmingham.

west-polynesia.title: Samowa da Tonga
west-polynesia.description: Samowa, Samowa ta Amurka, Tonga, Niue, Tokelau, da Wallis da Futuna — Apia, Pago Pago, Nukuʻalofa, Alofi da Mata-Utu; Upolu, Savaiʻi, Tutuila da tsibiran Tonga.

mariana-islands.title: Guam da Tsibiran Mariana ta Arewa
mariana-islands.description: Guam da Tsibiran Mariana ta Arewa — Hagåtña, Tamuning, Dededo, Saipan, Tinian da Rota.

greenland.title: Greenland
greenland.description: Greenland — Nuuk, Sisimiut, Ilulissat, Qaqortoq da Tasiilaq; babban ƙanƙarar ƙasar, Ilulissat Icefjord da fjord-fjord na kudu.

bermuda.title: Bermuda
bermuda.description: Bermuda — Hamilton, St. George’s da Royal Naval Dockyard, gundumomin tsibirin da rairayin bakin teku masu ruwan hoda.

belarus.title: Belarus
belarus.description: Belarus — Minsk, Gomel, Mogilev, Vitebsk, Grodno da Brest; dajin Belovezhskaya Pushcha da fadamun Polesia.

channel-islands.title: Tsibiran Channel
channel-islands.description: Jersey, Guernsey, Alderney, Sark da Herm — St Helier, St Peter Port da Gorey.

faroe-islands.title: Tsibiran Faroe
faroe-islands.description: Tsibiran Faroe — Tórshavn, Klaksvík, Runavík da tsibirai goma sha takwas, ƙauyukansu, ramukan hanya da tsaunukan bakin teku.

svalbard.title: Svalbard
svalbard.description: Svalbard da Jan Mayen — Longyearbyen, Barentsburg da Ny-Ålesund; ƙanƙara da fjord-fjord na Spitsbergen.

malta.title: Malta
malta.description: Malta, Gozo da Comino — Valletta, Sliema, St Julian’s, Mdina, Victoria da Birane Uku.

madagascar-islands.title: Madagaskar da Tsibiran Tekun Indiya
madagascar-islands.description: Madagaskar, Komoros, Mayotte, Réunion, Moris da Seychelles — Antananarivo, Toamasina, Moroni, Mamoudzou, Saint-Denis, Port Louis da Victoria.

sudan.title: Sudan
sudan.description: Sudan — Khartoum, Omdurman, Port Sudan, Kassala, El Obeid da Nyala; haɗuwar Kogin Nilu Shuɗi da Nilu Fari da dalan Meroë.

cabo-verde.title: Cabo Verde
cabo-verde.description: Cabo Verde — Praia, Mindelo, Santa Maria da tsibirai goma, daga Santo Antão zuwa Brava.

sao-tome-principe.title: São Tomé da Príncipe
sao-tome-principe.description: São Tomé da Príncipe — São Tomé, Santo António da dazuzzukan ruwan sama da rairayin bakin teku na tsibiran biyu.

saint-helena.title: Saint Helena, Ascension da Tristan da Cunha
saint-helena.description: Saint Helena, Tsibirin Ascension da Tristan da Cunha — Jamestown, Georgetown da Edinburgh of the Seven Seas.

bangladesh.title: Bangladesh
bangladesh.description: Bangladesh — Dhaka, Chittagong, Khulna, Rajshahi, Sylhet da Cox’s Bazar; Sundarbans da yankin bakin kogin Ganges da Brahmaputra.

sri-lanka-maldives.title: Sri Lanka da Maldives
sri-lanka-maldives.description: Sri Lanka da Maldives — Colombo, Kandy, Galle, Jaffna, Trincomalee, Anuradhapura da Malé; ƙasar tuddai, Sigiriya da tsibiran atoll.

vietnam.title: Vietnam
vietnam.description: Vietnam — Hanoi, Birnin Ho Chi Minh, Da Nang, Hai Phong, Hue, Hoi An da Can Tho; Gaɓar Ha Long da yankin bakin kogin Mekong.

philippines.title: Filipin
philippines.description: Filipin — Manila, Quezon City, Cebu, Davao, Iloilo, Baguio da Zamboanga; Luzon, Visayas, Mindanao da Palawan.

indonesia.title: Indonesiya da Timor-Leste
indonesia.description: Indonesiya da Timor-Leste — Jakarta, Surabaya, Bandung, Medan, Yogyakarta, Denpasar, Makassar da Dili; Java, Sumatra, Bali, Borneo, Sulawesi da Papua.

malaysia-singapore-brunei.title: Malaisiya, Singapore da Brunei
malaysia-singapore-brunei.description: Malaisiya, Singapore da Brunei — Kuala Lumpur, Singapore, George Town, Johor Bahru, Malacca, Kota Kinabalu, Kuching da Bandar Seri Begawan.

myanmar.title: Myanmar
myanmar.description: Myanmar — Yangon, Mandalay, Naypyidaw, Bagan, Mawlamyine da Tafkin Inle; kwarin Irrawaddy da tuddan Shan.

cambodia-laos.title: Kambodiya da Laos
cambodia-laos.description: Kambodiya da Laos — Phnom Penh, Siem Reap da Angkor, Battambang, Vientiane, Luang Prabang da Pakse; Kogin Mekong da Tonlé Sap.

colombia.title: Kolombiya
colombia.description: Kolombiya — Bogotá, Medellín, Cali, Barranquilla, Cartagena da Bucaramanga; tsaunukan Andes, gaɓar Karibiya da Amazon.

venezuela.title: Benezuwela
venezuela.description: Benezuwela — Caracas, Maracaibo, Valencia, Barquisimeto, Mérida da Ciudad Bolívar; Angel Falls, Kogin Orinoco da Isla Margarita.

peru.title: Peru
peru.description: Peru — Lima, Arequipa, Cusco, Trujillo, Iquitos da Puno; Machu Picchu, Tafkin Titicaca da Kwari Mai Tsarki.

ecuador.title: Ekwador
ecuador.description: Ekwador — Quito, Guayaquil, Cuenca, Manta da Baños; Hanyar Duwatsu Masu Aman Wuta, Amazon da Tsibiran Galápagos.

bolivia.title: Bolibiya
bolivia.description: Bolibiya — La Paz, El Alto, Santa Cruz, Cochabamba, Sucre da Potosí; Tafkin Titicaca da Salar de Uyuni.

chile.title: Cile
chile.description: Cile — Santiago, Valparaíso, Concepción, Antofagasta, La Serena da Punta Arenas; Atacama, yankin tafkuna, Patagonia da Tsibirin Easter.

paraguay-uruguay.title: Paraguay da Uruguay
paraguay-uruguay.description: Paraguay da Uruguay — Asunción, Ciudad del Este, Encarnación, Montevideo, Punta del Este da Colonia del Sacramento.

guianas.title: Ƙasashen Guiana
guianas.description: Guyana, Suriname da Guiana ta Faransa — Georgetown, Paramaribo, Cayenne da Kourou; Kaieteur Falls da dajin ruwan sama na Guiana Shield.

falklands.title: Tsibiran Falkland
falklands.description: Tsibiran Falkland — Stanley, Goose Green da tsibiran East Falkland da West Falkland.

australia.title: Ostareliya
australia.description: Ostareliya — Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, Adelaide, Hobart, Darwin da Canberra; Great Barrier Reef, Uluru da Outback.

new-zealand.title: Sabuwar Zelandiya
new-zealand.description: Sabuwar Zelandiya — Auckland, Wellington, Christchurch, Hamilton, Dunedin da Queenstown; Southern Alps, Fiordland da Rotorua.

british-columbia.title: British Columbia
british-columbia.description: British Columbia — Vancouver, Victoria, Kelowna, Kamloops, Prince George da Whistler; Coast Mountains, Tsibirin Vancouver da Okanagan.

canadian-prairies.title: Filayen Prairie na Kanada
canadian-prairies.description: Alberta, Saskatchewan da Manitoba — Calgary, Edmonton, Winnipeg, Saskatoon, Regina da Banff; tsaunukan Rockies, filayen prairie da Churchill a gaɓar Hudson Bay.

ontario.title: Ontario
ontario.description: Ontario — Toronto, Ottawa, Mississauga, Hamilton, London, Kingston da Thunder Bay; Niagara Falls, Manyan Tafkuna da Algonquin Park.

quebec.title: Quebec
quebec.description: Quebec — Montréal, Birnin Quebec, Laval, Gatineau, Sherbrooke da Saguenay; Kogin St. Lawrence, tsaunukan Laurentians da yankin Gaspé.

atlantic-canada.title: Kanada ta Atlantika
atlantic-canada.description: New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island, da Newfoundland da Labrador — Halifax, St. John’s, Moncton, Saint John, Fredericton da Charlottetown; Cabot Trail da Bay of Fundy.

northern-canada.title: Arewacin Kanada
northern-canada.description: Yukon, Northwest Territories da Nunavut — Whitehorse, Yellowknife, Iqaluit, Dawson City da Inuvik; tsibiran Arctic Archipelago da Kogin Mackenzie.

hong-kong-macau.title: Hong Kong da Macau
hong-kong-macau.description: Hong Kong da Macau — Tsibirin Hong Kong, Kowloon, New Territories, Lantau da yankin Macau, Taipa da Coloane.

antarctica.title: Antatika
antarctica.description: Antatika — McMurdo Station, Scott Base da Villa Las Estrellas; Antarctic Peninsula, tsibiran South Shetland, Ross Ice Shelf da Dutsen Erebus. Taswirar tana ƙarewa a 85° kudu, ba ta kai South Pole ba.
